reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains clear invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Nummer: 1119105111", invoice-like sections, totals and VAT summary — therefore treated as invoice (not a payment reminder or report).

Locate fields:
- Invoice date: found near top right "Datum 24.11.2023" → Invoice.Date = "24.11.2023".
- Sender VAT ID: top block shows "VAT Registration n° ATU39103108" and repeated in footer "ATU39103108" → Sender.VatId = "ATU39103108".
- VAT groups: VAT summary at end shows single VAT group "10,00 %", VAT amount "5.122,27", net value "51.222,66", gross total "56.344,93".
  - Vat.Rate = 10 (drop percent sign per rules).
  - Net.Amount = 51.222,66 (preserve decimals as in document).
  - Vat.Amount = 5.122,27.
- Grand total: Gesamtsumme brutto = 56.344,93 → GrandTotal.Amount = 56.344,93.

Verification and alternatives considered:
- Multiple VAT rates? Checked VAT summary: only "10,00 %" present, so single VAT group.
- Possible confusion with "Zahlung bis" lines: these show discounted or net payable dates but do not change invoice grand total; main gross total is 56.344,93.
- Sender VAT appears unambiguous; customer UID (ATU22642807) is recipient VAT but schema requests Sender.VatId, so used ATU39103108.

No guessing used for any field; values taken exactly from invoice text.
